text:
marie_cs: FYI — Nimbus Logistics reached out requesting onboarding of a custom 'route-summary' model that summarizes driver incident logs. They flagged potential PHI in free-text notes and want tight controls + fast evals. Asked if we can do a private deployment or dedicated capacity.

jamie_ml: got it. do we know model size/arch? quantized or fp16? will affect our onboarding path.

marie_cs: customer said it’s a finetuned Llama-13B variant, currently 13B fp16. pref for private VPC but open to Dedicated if needed. timeline: wants results before renewal conversation in ~3 weeks. renewal risk if onboarding slips.

sanjay_security: PHI = high risk. we need a dataflow diagram, proof of KMS usage, and PII/PHI handling checklist signed. also confirm delete-on-exit for KV cache. Can we get a sample redacted log set for evals (not production PHI)?

chris_research: for evals we’ll need: 1) a golden set (50–200 examples) with expected summaries, 2) safety tests for hallucinations/PII leakage, 3) latency/throughput target. I can spin up an eval harness once we have samples.

olivia_eng: capacity question — 13B fp16 on dedicated GPUs is fine. if they want private VPC on prem, need capacity plan. rough config we usually recommend:
```
vm: p4d.24xlarge (or equiv), gpus: 8, batch_size: 4-8 for 512 tokens, kv-ttl: 1h, cache-mode: prefix
```
If they want quantized 8-bit we can cut infra needs in half.

marie_cs: Nimbus is open to quantization if we show no perf regressions. I'll ask for the redacted sample set and their expected latency SLO. Also they want an enablement session for their MLops + security teams next Wed.

deploybot: Ticket CS-7893 created: "Nimbus Logistics — route-summary onboarding (PHI)". Assigning to jamie_ml, olivia_eng, sanjay_security, chris_research.

jamie_ml: I'll own the eval pipeline. pls drop the sample data and golden set in /secure/onboards/nimbus/ when ready. Also need their regen prompts and typical prompt templates.

sanjay_security: schedule a 30-min review with Nimbus security. I can prep the PHI checklist. Prefer meeting before enablement.

marie_cs: note on renewal: customer said "onboarding timeline will influence our renewal decision." this is high priority for CS/AM. I'll escalate to AM and ask Nimbus to prioritize sample delivery.

chris_research: quick plan: 1) get redacted sample + golden set (2 days), 2) run quality + hallucination suite (2 days), 3) security review + sign-off (1 day), 4) enablement + final rollout (2 days). optimistic total ~7 working days once we have data.

olivia_eng: flagged potential infra lead time if they insist on private on-prem. that could add 1–2 weeks. recommend Dedicated with VPC peering as speedier path.

marie_cs: thanks all. I'll follow up with Nimbus to get samples and confirm enablement slot. tagging @jamie_ml @sanjay_security for readiness. :eyes: 

jamie_ml: thanks — will prep eval harness and a checklist of needed artifacts.

sanjay_security: will send PHI checklist template and KMS docs.

marie_cs: last comment — capture feedback after enablement; if they’re happy we can accelerate renewal renewal+expansion pitch. otherwise escalate to sales.
